items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Mack Venable taught me when I was teaching with him -- studying with him in Philly.

ctx.x: jazz thing. I say, "Oh, look at this man." People don't know how great this man is. (Inaudible) every note so clean -- every note is so -- every note...
See, this is one thing that I tried to learn that Mack Venable taught me when I was teaching with him -- studying with him in Philly.
He tell me to come to practice Sunday afternoon and just bring your mouthpiece. See, just playing the horn is not all. It's what you do with that mouthpiece.
